entities.summary: Charles Allen Ragan is an American singer, songwriter, guitarist, and author. He is the guitarist and vocalist of the band Hot Water Music. Ragan has also authored a book and released a variety of solo material, including five studio albums, two soundtracks, and two live albums, among other releases.
